💡 The novelty lies in combining V-doping with interlayer engineering of MoS2/rGO composites to simultaneously address poor conductivity and structural instability. This synergistic strategy enhances interlayer spacing, phase modulation, and electron transport, delivering improved capacity and cycling stability. It offers a promising design route for high-performance, durable AZIB cathodes.

item.title: Oxygen Evolution along Grain Boundaries of LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2 Particles as an Early Stage Degradation of High-Voltage All-Solid-State Batteries
item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying grain boundaries as the dominant pathway for O2 release in polycrystalline NCM523, with surface oxygen-vacancy formation initiating propagation along GBs. This explains early degradation of high-voltage sulfide all-solid-state batteries and establishes suppressing surface oxygen vacancies, e.g., via coating, as a key strategy for long-term stability.
